Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the
High Court be pleased to suspend the sentence awarded to the
applicant/appellant in the judgment dated 08.11.2024 in Sc No.348/2023 on
the files of the Fast Track Special Court, Kannur, pending the final
disposal of the appeal and release the petitioner on bail.

This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application
and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.Nandagopal S.Kurup, Adith Kiran
R.S., Advocates for the petitioner and of the Public Prosecutor for
respondent, the court passed the following:
 P.T.O.

sentences.text: the Fast Track Special Court, Kannur.
The applicant/accused has been found guilty of the offences punishable under Sections 354A(1)(i), 376 and 376(2)(n) IPC.
He has been sentenced to varying terms of imprisonment for the aforesaid offences.
The sentences have been directed to run concurrently.
The maximum period of imprisonment he will have to undergo is ten years.
2. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant/accused that the offences punishable under Sections 376 and 376(2)(n) are not made out.
The engagement of the in applicant/accused to PW1, the victim, took place on 28/06/2021.

At the instance of PW1 they had coitus on 29/10/2021,
24/01/2022 and 15/02/2022 at different places.
Thereafter, the parents of the applicant/accused came to know that the person who was introduced as the father of PW1 was actually not her father and that he was her mother's paramour.
When they came to know about this, the family of the applicant/accused was not inclined to go ahead with the marriage.

The mother of the applicant/accused intimated this to the mother of PW1 on 09/04/2022, on which day the mother of PW1 as well as the person who was stated to be her father went to the house of the applicant/accused.

An altercation and scuffle occurred, relating to which crime no.212/2022,
Pazhayangadi Police Station was registered.
Exts.D1 and D2 are the FIR and FIS in the said crime.
The said crime was registered on 16/04/2022.
The FIS and FIR in this case was given subsequent to the incident that took place on 09/04/2022, that is, on 13/04/2022.

It is also submitted by the in learned counsel for the applicant/accused that the evidence would show that it was PW1 who took the initiative for booking hotel rooms pursuant to which both of them had occupied the said room and engaged in coitus.
Therefore, the argument is that the offence of rape is not made out and that it was a consensual relationship and hence the sentence may be suspended 3.
The application is opposed by the learned Public Proseuctor.
4. Heard both sides.
5. On going through the impugned judgment, the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant/accused seems justified.
The applicant/accused seems to have an arguable case.
Moreover, the appeal is of the year 2024.
So there is no possibility of the appeal being taken up for hearing in the near future.
